description.narrative: The ‘Research, Advocate and Advance: Strengthening Pathways for Equality based on Sexual Orientation, Gender Identity and Expression, and Sex Characteristics (SOGIESC)’ project aims to support LGBTI activists from ODA recipient countries protect their rights, to better link national and regional members to advocacy opportunities at the UN and to provide capacity building and other support. The objectives are to advocate within the UPR and other mechanisms, utilize global and national data, and implement national advocacy campaigns that incorporate UN recommendations and impactful data. The key activities include the collection, analysis and dissemination of legal and social information and best practices of international relevance; the documentation, monitoring and sharing of Human Rights violations, media coverage and legal and legislative action by governments, with LGBTI led organisations, and other stakeholders; and the creation and maintaining of specific spaces for people and issues of marginalized and diverse SOGIESC to talk about international norms and movement building.
